Libraries Pro: Unlock the Studio for every library

name: Studio (Libraries.dev)
summary: Live workbench for tuning every parameter of the Libraries.dev React effect libraries and exporting the exact code.
description: The Studio is one workbench for all Libraries.dev effect libraries: every parameter is tuned live on the real component, beyond what the public playgrounds expose, and exported as props. A built-in AI agent dials in a look from a description. It is the paid part of Libraries Pro ($9/month).
